preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 26 closes the legal core with the first-fruits ritual (vv. 1–11), including the historical credo 'A wandering Aramean was my father' (vv. 5–10), and the third-year tithe declaration. 4QDeutᶠ and 4QDeutⁱ preserve vv. 1–5. The credo is one of the oldest cores of Israelite confession and is preserved at Qumran with no significant variation.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The 'wandering Aramean' (arami oved avi) credo tracks MT.

variant_notes: 'A wandering Aramean was my father, and he went down into Egypt' tracks MT. This historical credo is the structural core of Israel's covenant theology and the basis of the Passover Haggadah.
